title: Summer Heat

items.label: Bare Walkway
items.description: A pedestrian crosses a long sunlit path with no shade nearby.
items.visual_focus: a pedestrian crossing an exposed path in strong sun with no nearby shade
items.local_cue: a treeless Rajshahi footpath with concrete curb under a strong summer sun

items.label: Hot Shelter
items.description: People wait under a low roof while fanning themselves in trapped heat.
items.visual_focus: people fanning themselves under a low heat-trapping roof
items.local_cue: people beneath a low corrugated metal shop roof in Rajshahi summer heat

items.label: Skipping Water
items.description: A busy worker keeps serving customers while pushing aside a water bottle.
items.visual_focus: a working vendor pushing aside a water bottle while continuing to serve
items.local_cue: a Rajshahi market vendor serving customers beside a drinking-water bottle

items.label: Midday Queue
items.description: Several people wait in direct sun while a person searches for shade.
items.visual_focus: a queue of people standing in direct midday sun
items.local_cue: a queue outside a modest Rajshahi shop in strong midday sun

items.label: Putting Up Shade
items.description: A worker sets a temporary cloth over a waiting place with no permanent canopy.
items.visual_focus: a worker pulling shade cloth over a waiting area
items.local_cue: a worker stretching shade cloth across a small bazaar waiting area

items.label: Fan Left Off
items.description: A shopkeeper turns away from an electric fan beside a high stack of bills.
items.visual_focus: a shopkeeper holding a bill beside a switched-off electric fan
items.local_cue: a Bangladeshi shopkeeper beside an off ceiling fan and an electricity bill in taka

questions: Which two scenes give people the least relief from heat?
What helps you stay comfortable on a hot day in Rajshahi?
Should shade go first to walkers or people waiting in queues? Why?
Why might a worker continue outside during the hottest hour?
If a new shelter blocks shop entrances, who is affected?
You have 200,000 BDT and 30 days. What one heat-relief change would your grant test?

grant.pilot_scope: Test shade and water access at one exposed public waiting point.
